The '''''Journal of Singularities''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[open-access]] [[scientific journal]] which publishes research in the area of [[singularity theory]]. It was established in 2010 by [[David B. Massey]], who remains [[editor-in-chief]]. It is published by the [[Worldwide Center of Mathematics]].<ref name=Home>{{cite web |title=Journal of Singularities |website=Homepage |url=https://www.journalofsing.org/}}</ref>
